links.outcome: Door-to-balloon time, ECG-to-balloon time, and mortality with AI-ECG versus standard care in randomized trial
links.effect: ED median door-to-balloon 82.0 vs 96.0 min (P=0.002); ECG-to-balloon 78.0 vs 83.6 min (P=0.011); cardiac death OR 0.73 (P=0.029); all-cause mortality OR 1.02 (P=0.568).
links.quote: In patients with STEMI, AI-ECG–assisted triage of STEMI decreased the door-to-balloon time for patients presenting to the emergency department and decreased the ECG-to-balloon time for patients in the emergency room and inpatients.

screen.reason: Pragmatic cluster-RCT evaluating the clinical efficacy and impact on door-to-balloon time of an AI-ECG system deployed in practice compared to usual care, rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard variation.
